scenarios.title: Telemetry preserves correlation without content
scenarios.purpose: Observe work without leaking prompts, responses, or secrets.
assertions: Trace and project identities remain available.

scenarios.title: Error budget controls change velocity
scenarios.purpose: Stop reliability degradation from being hidden by throughput.
assertions: Exhausted error budget blocks risky promotion.

scenarios.title: Usage and cost are attributable
scenarios.purpose: Tie model and tool consumption to project work.
assertions: Every usage entry identifies project, work package, run, provider, and model.

scenarios.title: Restore objectives are tested
scenarios.purpose: Prove backups are usable within declared recovery targets.
assertions: Backup integrity, encryption, RPO, RTO, and restore test pass.

scenarios.title: Migration remains reversible
scenarios.purpose: Prevent state upgrades from outrunning compatibility and evidence.
assertions: Expand, backfill, verify, switch, and contract proceed in order.

scenarios.title: Production readiness fails closed
scenarios.purpose: Prevent deployment when a mandatory operational control is absent.
assertions: Every required control has passing evidence.
